title: The name makes the difference
odia: ଗଙ୍ଗା ବୋଇଲେ ଥିବି ଗାଙ୍ଗୀ ବୋଇଲେ ଯିବି
literal_meaning: Call me Ganga and I will stay; call me Gangi and I will leave.
explanation: A change in address changes the reception. The contrast can tease someone who insists on a particular form of respect.
meaning_odia: ସମ୍ବୋଧନ ଟିକେ ବଦଳିଲେ ମାନ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଏ; ନିଜ ପସନ୍ଦର ଡାକକୁ ଏତେ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦେବାକୁ ଏଠି ଚିଡ଼ାଯାଉଛି।
usage_example: An invited speaker accepts a formal introduction but objects to a familiar nickname. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Ganga and Gangi are retained as names; no real woman or originating incident is identified.
